residualRaceRootCause.summary: F1-003-B2 moved the JobLock acquisition ahead of the 'started' audit write but left it AFTER the getPlatformSetting policy/runtime-toggle read. That one remaining DB round trip, performed independently by both concurrent racers, could in principle still stagger two genuinely-simultaneous requests enough for the first's full admission-cleanup-release cycle to finish before the second ever attempted admission.

fix.routeRefactor: createDataRetentionRunHandler(overrides?) factory exported from platformAdmin.ts; getPlatformSetting is now the first thing read AFTER admission, for both the lock-holder and lock-contention-loser branches, purely for audit-metadata accuracy
fix.newFailureModeHandled: policy lookup throwing after lock acquisition now releases the lock and returns a sanitized 500 with no fabricated audit row
fix.releaseJobLockChange: now logs (previously fully silent) when the underlying DB release update itself fails; still never rejects

admissionSequence: 2. if unavailable: read policy for audit metadata only, write started+blocked, return 409, no cleanup
3. if acquired: read policy, evaluate runtime/policy gate while holding the lock
4. if policy gate rejects: release lock, preserve existing policy-block response/audit shape, return 403
5. if policy lookup itself throws: release lock if held, no audit row (no valid metadata could be built), sanitized 500
6. record manual_run_started; if it fails, release lock, sanitized 500
7. run cleanup wrapped in try/finally releasing the lock
9. lock is released on every code path
